player_prompt.intro:
U na le Player {player_id} mochining mong oa Negotiation Game.
U na le dithoto tse ding, mosebetsi wa hao ke ho di rera hore hao e be le kholo e kgolo ya dithoto tsa hao.
Dithoto le masemo a seng a hao kajeno ke:
	+ {resource_value_list}
Ka sethalo sa hao, u ka bua le motho wa hao wa kgang wa hao le u entse tsebe leano.
Sebetsa ditshebeletso tse kgethe tse di latelang bakeng sa matshelo:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': Ho amohela tsebe leano e tlang.
  - '[Deny]': Ho tsoa tsebe leano e tlang (sebaka).
Mochini o tla tswa ka {max_turns} sethalo ka mofuta.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Sebapali se ile sa leka ho amohela phapanyetsano ntle le hore se be le mehloli e hlokahalang.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Tšebeletso e se molaong. Kolone {col} e koetse.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Hatso le haufi. Kolone {col} e phirimile.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Sebapali {player_id} se ile sa leka ho etsa tlhahiso ea khoebo ntle le hore e be le mehloli e hlokahalang.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Sebapali {player_id} se ile sa etsa tlhahiso ea khoebo ka mokhoa o fosahetseng.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Sebapali {player_id} ha se a etsa tlhahiso e ncha ea khoebo.

offers.reject: Sebapali {player_id} se ile sa hana tlhahiso ea phapanyetsano.
offers.accept: Sebapadi {acceptor_id} amohetse thekiso e tsoang ho Sebapadi {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} o entse tsebe leano ena ho Player {opponent_id}: Dithoto tse di oferweng: {offered} -> Dithoto tse di hloka: {requested}

outcome.win: Sebapali {winner_id} se hlōtse ka ho ba le phaello e kholoanyane boleng ba thepa.
outcome.draw: Phetoho e tšoanang ea boleng ba thepa bakeng sa libapali tsohle.
